description: Elastic constants: tight relax, then IBRION=6 at ENCUT=1000 (the stress response is far more cutoff-sensitive than the energy), then -elasticd. The relaxed cell must be the input: a symmetry-broken starting structure gives a tensor that cannot be inverted.

stages.note: -elasticd needs OUTCAR, the elastic tensor, and POSCAR (for the space group template). POSCAR falls back to the root copy if 00-relax left none.
